story.title: Yemeni Government Forces Withdraw from Red Sea Amid Houthi Advances
story.summary: Yemeni government forces have retreated from the area near the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, marking a significant setback for the Saudi-backed coalition in the ongoing civil war. This withdrawal is aimed at consolidating defenses around their main base in Aden as the Iran-aligned Houthi militia continues to gain ground.

related_stories.title: Spain Reports Nearly 2,200 Migrants Arrive in Canary Islands Over Two Days
related_stories.summary: Spain has reported that nearly 2,200 migrants reached the Canary Islands within a two-day period. This surge in arrivals, particularly from sub-Saharan Africa, prompted Spain to declare a migration emergency on November 11. The situation reflects a significant increase in migration attempts to the islands in recent weeks.

related_stories.title: Estonia to Close All Border Crossings with Russia Following Drone Factory Attack
related_stories.summary: Estonia will close all its border crossings with Russia starting December 1, following a suspected sabotage attack on Threod Systems, a drone manufacturer. Authorities have linked the attack to Russia's GRU military intelligence service, claiming it is part of hybrid warfare. Eight individuals were arrested in connection with the incident, which involved an attempted arson at the facility.

related_stories.title: Zelenskyy Warns Starshield Restrictions Compromise Ukraine's Energy Defense Ahead of Winter
related_stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed concerns that restrictions on the Starshield satellite communications system are undermining Ukraine's ability to defend its energy infrastructure against Russian attacks. He stated that these limitations hinder the interception of Russian drones, particularly as winter approaches, a time when attacks on Ukraine's power grid typically escalate. Zelenskyy has called on the U.S. and Elon Musk to lift these restrictions to bolster Ukraine's defenses.

related_stories.title: Philippines and Australia Enhance Military Cooperation at ASEAN Summit
related_stories.summary: The annual ASEAN summit commenced in Manila, Philippines, bringing together Southeast Asian leaders for discussions focused on trade, energy, and regional conflicts. Among the key topics is the strengthening of military deterrence between the Philippines and Australia, highlighting their commitment to regional security amidst ongoing global tensions.
